author: Standing organism evaluator

selection_protocol.status: Unchanged since selection, before intervening observations were inspected.

selection.rank_meaning: 1-based quality order in this frame only, not an identity label
selection.position_description: Upper-left quadrant, about one-third across and one-fifth down from the top in a full-domain view; rounded triangular outer enclosure with an internal curled pattern.
selection.visible_feature: A separate internal hooked/curled A1 stripe with an interior low-A1 bay, lying inside a closed outer A1 boundary and separated from it by an A0-rich band. A0 is blue and A1 orange in the legacy composite; the existing native movie displays A0 cyan and A1 pale cream in separate fixed-scale panels.
selection.allowed_feature_changes: Rotation, smooth deformation, motion and intensity variation may occur; exact outline and pixels need not be identical. The nested boundary/intermediate band/internal curled-stripe organization must remain discernible.

selection_bias: Selected retrospective review, not blinded confirmation. P7 snapshots at t25,250,750 were inspected before this selection; the final appearance influenced selection of a promising example. No prevalence or held-out success claim.
review_method: Evaluator visual judgments from every full-domain A0/A1 panel and the same fixed supplementary detail crop; no numerical tracking or feature calculation. Status rows are manually assigned following visual inspection.

evidence_window.ancestry_before250: Not reviewed in this bounded study; earlier t25 snapshot was known before selection.
evidence_window.gate_scope: Support for visible organization and sampled apparent identity of this selected individual in this window. No material-continuity, confinement, autonomous-maintenance or replication claim.

localized_coherent_individual.evidence: The selected outer A1 contour remains closed and visually separable from surrounding patterns in all 201 retained samples.
localized_coherent_individual.limit: A rendered field contour does not establish material identity or a confining membrane.

distinguishing_nontrivial_feature.evidence: A separate curled A1 stripe with a low-A1 bay and intermediate A0-rich band remains discernible inside the outer contour.
distinguishing_nontrivial_feature.limit: Spatial organization is observed; causal functional roles are not established.

same_individual_feature_persistence.evidence: The same apparent enclosure and frozen nested feature are supported at every retained sample from time 250 through time 750. No observed failure or identity ambiguity.
same_individual_feature_persistence.limit: Sampled apparent identity; right-censored at 750. Events between samples and material continuity are not resolved.

promotion.status: Organism-like candidate at the level of visible organization and sampled apparent identity.
promotion.updates: Initial calibration reported insufficient persistence evidence. This bounded review supplies that missing evidence without changing the rubric.

interpretation_strength.competing_interpretation: A mostly stationary stable patterned island remains a viable explanation.
interpretation_strength.initialization: Fresh noisy CPU realization initialized with default dressed pokes and inhibitor-shadow kicks; not a reconstruction of the archived GPU trajectory.
interpretation_strength.ancestry: Not reviewed before time 250. No spontaneous-origin claim.
interpretation_strength.display_scope: Every full-domain A0/A1 panel and fixed detail crop reviewed. Source movie displays four of eight fields; complete chemistry not evaluated.
interpretation_strength.generalization: One retrospectively selected candidate. No held-out success-rate or prevalence claim.

next_design_recommendation.priority: Specify one bounded P7 boundary-dependent maintenance challenge before the held feedback experiment or replication work.
next_design_recommendation.question: Does the intact outer boundary help restore the specified internal feature after a standardized local interior disturbance?
next_design_recommendation.comparison: Apply the same interior disturbance with intact boundary, selective boundary lesion, and matched nonboundary damage, with sham controls. Freeze exact perturbations, recovery window and unchanged feature criterion before admission.

outcome_decisions.selective_recovery_with_intact_boundary: Supports boundary-dependent maintenance beyond matched damage and sham effects; advance this candidate while retaining autonomy limits.
outcome_decisions.equal_recovery_regardless_of_boundary_or: Visual persistence remains supported; maintenance remains unsupported. Retain as visual benchmark, redirect priority, and do not automatically retune.
outcome_decisions.ambiguous_or_invalid_comparison: Insufficient evidence. End this proposal without a parameter sweep.

next_design_recommendation.rubric_effect: No fourth essential gate added; this tests strength of interpretation.
next_design_recommendation.held_experiment: activity-paid-restoring-feedback-reference-v2 remains held; no automatic rewrite or run.
